title: Use the machine.
prompt: The rule is x[n+1] = 3x[n] + 1 and x[0] = 2. What is x[1]?
hint: Substitute the present state 2 into the rule.

feedback.pass: 3 × 2 + 1 = 7. The current state and the update rule determine this next state.
feedback.fail: Apply the entire rule to 2: multiply by 3, then add 1.
